findings.failure_path: An absolute directory argument follows a symlink before project-root discovery. If a checkout directory points into an external project that contains render/colors.go, the external project can become root_real. The containment check then accepts that file, and --allow=render can produce exit 0 without inspecting it. The relative spelling anchors to the checkout and keeps the external target ineligible.
findings.smallest_fix: Select the exemption root from the lexical scan location before following directory symlinks. Compare canonical targets against that root and add an absolute-directory regression alongside the existing symlinked-file cases.

findings.failure_path: For a markerless project outside the working directory, scanning the project directory with --allow=render exempts render/nested/colors.go. Passing that same file by absolute path makes its grandparent, render, the root, which removes the render segment and causes a finding. A file immediately inside render remains exempt.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the target-grandparent heuristic. Use a documented project or scan anchor consistently for explicit files and directory walks, and add a regression that checks both entry paths for a nested renderer file.

findings.failure_path: The new sentence puts the asserted cap inside the phrase governed by “prefer.” A deterministic dual-path migration can therefore treat an uncapped known-difference list as a permissible departure from a preference. The supplied rule made the cap mandatory whenever such a list exists.
findings.smallest_fix: Give dual-path comparisons their own bullet and state separately that any exemption or known-difference list must have an asserted size cap.

findings.failure_path: The 229/229 exact-locator claim cannot be verified from the frozen packet. The second row points to authoring-patterns line 368 with an abbreviated heading, but the packet supplies neither that destination text nor candidate-bound row-level verifier output. The same gap affects other destinations outside the shown hunks.
findings.smallest_fix: Attach candidate-bound verifier output for all 229 rows with each resolved destination line and full heading, along with the destination excerpts needed to check the mappings.

concern_results.conclusion: The relative ancestor-render case and the repeat-call trigger are addressed. Absolute scans can still select a root that grants an unintended exemption, and the differential-testing size cap is phrased as a preference.
Both permission probes import scratch copies under python3 -B. The checker reads source files, and its exemption boundary can fail open when an absolute directory argument resolves through a symlink.
The containment check rejects paths outside the selected root, but absolute directory scans can select the symlink destination as that root. Absolute file fallback also changes with file depth.

The new fixtures isolate the constructor-wrapped false branch and cover symlinked files. They omit absolute symlinked directory arguments and markerless file-versus-directory parity. Suite execution was not independently verified, and the shown AST invocations do not substantiate the ledger’s -W error claim.

The command adds no options or rollout steps. The absolute-file grandparent heuristic changes exemption behavior for existing markerless scans based on file depth and how the caller supplies the path.
The changed checker, tests, and guidance require no data migration or deployment ordering. The validation ledger leaves boundary acceptance pending.
The visible missing-path and unsupported-type diagnostics are preserved. An erroneous exemption skips inspection before any finding can be emitted, so the affected scan can exit 0 silently.

The packet confirms the two entrypoint edits and some adjacent locators. Most destination text, the row-level verifier output, and the complete entrypoint needed to verify the exact size counts are absent.
The shared gate must establish the scan boundary before resolving an argument through symlinks. The absolute-directory branch instead derives that boundary from the destination.
